Title: Edged Illusion v Memories of Mortality

Messages.Author: J
Messages.Body:
Joaquina Amaya has a Memories of Mortality on her and plays Edged
Illusion targeting an Imbued player. How do these cards interact?
Does Memories only protect from combat damage?

Name: Edged Illusion
[KMW:C]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Chimerstry
[chi] (D) Tap a ready minion.This acting vampire inflicts 1
unpreventable damage on that minion.
[CHI] (D) Choose a Methuselah. This acting vampire inflicts 1
unpreventable damage on each ready minion controlled by that
Methuselah.

Name: Memories of Mortality
[AH:U5, CE:U]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master.
Put this card on a vampire; this vampire cannot attempt to block
allies. Any damage this vampire inflicts on allies is reduced to 0.
This vampire may burn 1 blood during his or her controller's influence
phase to burn this card; he or she then goes into torpor.

>From reading the cards, it appears that Memories doesn't care when the
damage is done - if it is done to an ally by **this vampire**, then it
is reduced to 0. Pertinent point of Edged Illusion - "This acting
vampire inflicts".

So I would say that the damage is effectively negated - is this
correct?

--> J
grail_pbem "at" hotmail.com

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, the damage done to an ally by the MoM vampire is reduced to zero.
